title: netcoredbg debug configuration
description: Configuration for debugging .NET applications with netcoredbg

request.description: 'launch' starts the program under the debugger, 'attach' connects to an already running process

program.description: Path to the assembly to debug (e.g. bin/Debug/net9.0/MyApp.dll). netcoredbg runs it with the `dotnet` host.

args.description: Command line arguments passed to the program

cwd.description: Working directory of the launched program. Defaults to the worktree root.

env.description: Environment variables for the launched program

stopAtEntry.description: Break at the program entry point

justMyCode.description: Only step through and break in user code, skipping framework and library code

enableStepFiltering.description: Automatically step over properties and operators

processId.description: Id of the .NET process to attach to
